title: Parallel Coordinates
intent: Create one polyline per observation across an ordered set of quantitative or categorical dimensions.
useWhen: Use this recipe when multivariate profiles and tradeoffs across several dimensions need comparison.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe for fewer than three useful dimensions or datasets whose overplotting cannot be reduced.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.
